title: Duppler: Bessent's AI Outlook Is Optimistic, But Plausible
title_cn: Duppler：Bessent 的人工智能前景乐观，但似乎合理
summary: Mattie Duppler, Senior Fellow for Fiscal Policy at the National Taxpayers Union and Founder and President of Forward Strategies, discusses Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's closing remarks at the G20 in Ashville. Duppler calls Bessent's expectation for a major AI-driven productivity shift within six months "very optimistic," but says the rapid pace of technological change means it cannot be ruled out. She speaks with Kailey Leinz on Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Palantir’s Karp Will Back Startup by Ex-Ukraine Defense Chief
title_cn: Palantir 的卡普将支持前乌克兰国防部长创办的初创公司
summary: Alex Karp, Palantir Technologies Inc.’s chief executive officer, is set to become the first major investor in a defense technology company proposed by Ukraine’s former defense minister as the country continues to battle invading Russian forces.
